question: is Strata's advertised 93.9-101.4 tok/s decode at 32K real on this card and pack, with --tune settled and the 10.47 GB pack whole-resident?
answer: no: their engine puts 2,604-2,618 of 3,072 experts in VRAM (6.85-6.88 GiB) and 454-468 on the SSD, and at 32K it offloads 21,760-28,160 KV tokens to host RAM. Measured decode at 32,126 tokens: 5.1 tok/s (fp16 KV, drafter idle) and 13.6 tok/s (fp8 KV, drafter 38/91 drafts). The best cell found on this box is 42.5 tok/s at 3,934 tokens.

engine.tune: `strata tune auto inkling-2-mini-sq-10 --plan` says: "Inkling-2-Mini needs no tuning: its speed and memory placement are set automatically by strata-inkling." No presets exist (`strata presets list`: none), so the auto placement below IS the settled state.

residency_their_own_log.experts_ssd: 454-468, read through a 119-slot pinned DMA ring of 509 MiB
residency_their_own_log.kv_fp16_at_32768: 4608 VRAM + 28160 mapped host tokens (880.0 MiB host RAM)
residency_their_own_log.kv_fp8_at_32768: 11008 VRAM + 21760 mapped host tokens (350.6 MiB host RAM)
residency_their_own_log.note: --vram-experts-gb 10.0 / 9.5 / 9.0 all ended at the same 6.85-6.88 GiB of experts: the engine's own placement caps it, and the whole pack + 32K of KV does not fit in the 11.3 GB free at launch (trunk 1.87 + all experts ~8.5 + KV ~0.5-1.0 + ring/workspace).

compare.claim: 93.9-101.4 tok/s decode at 32K on an RTX 5070 with a 10.47 GB pack that fits whole (Strata, advertised)
compare.our_branch_same_card: 24.94 tok/s at 63,977 tokens (spec off), 33.07 (spec on), measured on the same box (PLAN 15.19)

not_done_and_why.our_chain_on_a_10.4 GB_pack: not possible tonight: the 10.47 GB file is Strata's .strata v1.1 layout, which this engine does not read; our own packs are IQ3_XXS 11.66 GB and Q4_K_M 16.6 GB, and anything below IQ3 is an explicit dead end in the plan. So the pack-controlled A/B (our chain on a 10.4 GB pack of the same weights) still has no cell.
not_done_and_why.their_claim_at_a_true_32K_sequence: not reproducible here in any placement we could reach; the pack is 2,604-2,618/3,072 experts resident and 32K of KV does not fit beside it, so a whole-resident 32K run would need more than this card has.
